import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Handle NaN values in 'Sleep Disorder' column by filling with 'None'
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')

# Define a logical order for BMI Categories for better visualization
bmi_order = ['Underweight', 'Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
df['BMI Category'] = pd.Categorical(df['BMI Category'], categories=bmi_order, ordered=True)

# Create the visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))
sns.violinplot(
    data=df,
    x='BMI Category',
    y='Sleep Duration',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    palette='viridis',
    inner='quartile', # Shows quartiles within the violins
    linewidth=1.2
)

plt.title('Distribution of Sleep Duration by BMI Category and Sleep Disorder', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(fontsize=10)
plt.yticks(fontsize=10)
plt.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left', frameon=True)
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
